_instructions.quick_start: Copy this file to Data/Config/LLM/openai.json (for global use) or Portfolios/<PortfolioName>/LLM/openai.json (portfolio-specific) and paste your OpenAI API key into 'api_key'.

key_types.project_api_key: RECOMMENDED. Create a Project API key (starts with 'sk-proj-') at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys.
key_types.user_legacy_key: User-scoped keys (starts with 'sk-') are also supported.
key_types.credits_requirement: IMPORTANT: OpenAI API keys require a pre-funded credit balance in your organization account (https://platform.openai.com/settings/organization/billing). Unlike ChatGPT Plus subscriptions, API usage is billed separately. A key with $0 credit balance will fail with 'You have no credits remaining' and show as a red '🔴 (no credits)' dot in AdvisorBot.
key_types.azure_openai: For Azure OpenAI endpoints, update 'api_base_url' to your deployment endpoint (e.g. 'https://<resource>.openai.azure.com/openai/deployments/<deployment-id>/chat/completions?api-version=2024-02-15-preview') and provide your Azure key.
key_types.local_proxies: If running an OpenAI-compatible proxy (such as Ollama, LocalAI, vLLM, or LM Studio), set 'api_base_url' to 'http://localhost:11434/v1/chat/completions' and use any non-empty 'api_key' like 'ollama'.

_instructions.environment_variable_alternative: Instead of pasting your key here, you can set export OPENAI_API_KEY='sk-proj-...' in your shell (~/.bashrc or ~/.zshrc). If 'api_key' in this file is empty or starts with 'PASTE_YOUR_', AdvisorBot will automatically read OPENAI_API_KEY from your environment.
_instructions.privacy_shield: Direct OpenAI cloud endpoints enforce your active Privacy Shield mode: Mode B ('identity_aliased') pseudonymizes investor/account/institution/ticker identities while keeping dollar values unscaled for exact tax math; Mode C ('identity_and_values') also scales dollar values and shifts birth years; 'local_only' restricts requests to loopback/localhost URLs.
